name: Liara Portyr
backstory:
Liara Portyr is a Baldur's Gate patriar from the well-off and influential Portyr patriar family. She was in command of Fort Beluarian in Chult, where she arranged a deal with local pirates that allowed for the safe passage of Baldurian trade vessels, as well as planning the search and acquisition of relics and treasure from the jungle.

During the events of , Liara Portyr was recalled to Baldur's Gate, where she served as the acting marshal of the Flaming Fist until Duke Ravengard's return. Gortash eventually planned to make Liara Portyr subservient to the Absolute by infecting her with a Mind Flayer Tadpole, before threatening her uncle, Dillard Portyr, into resigning his seat on the Ducal Council in her favour.

At the same time, Raphael planned to elevate Liara Portyr into the spotlight and reinforce her power through a series of schemes that involved a religious leader, the Flaming Fist commander of the , and an unknown individual with a position in the Flaming Fist barracks.
